title: कक्षा दसको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा उखानटुक्काको प्रयोग Kakshya Dashko Nepal;i pathyapustakma Ukhantukkako Prayog
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कक्षा दसको नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त उखानटुक्काहरूसङ्कलन गरी तिनको प्रयोग सन्दर्भ, अर्थ तथा प्रयोगको औचित्य र उपयुक्तताको निर्धारणगरिएको छ । गुणात्मक ढाँचामा संरचित यस लेखमा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन पुस्तकालयीयअध्ययन र तथ्याङ्कको विश्लेषण वर्णनात्मक विधिबाट गरिएको छ । अध्ययनको प्राथमिकस्रोतका रूपमा कक्षा दसको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकलाई लिइएको छ । निर्धारित पाठ्यपुस्तकबाटउखानटुक्काहरू सङ्कलन गरी तिनको विवरणात्मक प्रस्तुति, प्रयोग सन्दर्भ र अर्थलाईतालिकामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ भने तालिकाको व्याख्या विश्लेषणबाट निष्कर्षमा पुगिएको छ ।निर्धारित पाठ्यपुस्तकमा जम्मा चौहत्तरओटा उखानटुक्का प्रयोग भएका छन् । जसमाउखान नौओटा र टुक्का पैँसट्ठीओटा रहेका छन् । यस अध्ययनबाट अधिकांश उखानहरूवाक्यात्मक प्रकृतिका रहेका, व्रिmयायुक्त टुक्काको बाहुल्य रहेको, उखानको सङ्ख्या न्यून रहेको तथा केही टुक्काहरू जटिल प्रकृतिका भएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, proverbs and idioms used in the tenth-grade Nepali language textbook have been collected, and their context of usage, meaning, and the rationale and appropriateness of their use have been determined. Structured within a qualitative framework, data collection in this article was carried out through library research, and data analysis was conducted using descriptive methods. The tenth-grade Nepali textbook was taken as the primary source of the study. Having gathered proverbs and idioms from the prescribed textbook, their descriptive presentation, contextual usage, and meanings are laid out in tables, while conclusions have been reached through the interpretation and analysis of the tables. A total of seventy-four proverbs and idioms are used in the prescribed textbook. Among these, there are nine proverbs and sixty-five idioms. This study concludes that most proverbs are sentential in nature, verb-based idioms predominate, the number of proverbs is small, and certain idioms are complex in nature.
british_english: In the present article, the proverbs and idiomatic expressions used in the Class 10 Nepali language textbook have been collected, and their context of use, meaning, and the justification and suitability of their usage have been determined. Structured within a qualitative framework, data collection in this paper was conducted through library research and data analysis via descriptive methods. The Class 10 Nepali textbook was taken as the primary source of the study. Having gathered the proverbs and idioms from the set textbook, their descriptive presentation, context of use and meaning are presented in tables, whilst conclusions have been reached from the interpretation and analysis of the tables. In total, seventy-four proverbs and idioms are used in the set textbook. Amongst these, nine are proverbs and sixty-five are idioms. From this study, it is concluded that the majority of proverbs are sentential in nature, verb-containing idioms predominate, the number of proverbs is low, and some idioms are complex in character.

informal_english: In this paper, we’ve gathered up the proverbs and idioms used in the year ten Nepali language textbook to suss out their context of use, meaning, and just how justified and suitable they actually are. Structured in a qualitative framework, data collection was done through desk and library research while the data was sorted out using descriptive analysis. The year ten Nepali textbook was taken as the main primary source for the study. After pulling the proverbs and idioms out of the prescribed textbook, their descriptive breakdown, usage context, and meanings were laid out in tables, and conclusions were sorted from unpacking and analyzing those tables. All up, seventy-four proverbs and idioms get used in the prescribed textbook. Out of those, nine are proverbs and sixty-five are idioms. From this study, it’s concluded that most proverbs are full sentence-like in nature, idioms with verbs make up the bulk of the lot, the overall tally of proverbs is pretty low, and a few of the idioms are genuinely tricky in nature.
